fields.label: Archive history with missing source dependencies
fields.description: Reviewed exception: retain and report history requiring a User, Employee or Terms of Reference absent from the capture, and standalone assignments without a deployment or structured TOR. Original records and file references remain archived. Never invent a person, scope or approval. Source-present unresolved mappings still block. New history gaps retain the 1% review limit; approved person exclusions are counted separately.

fields.label: Reviewed history branch mappings
fields.description: Optional JSON object mapping source branch names to existing Geo Node IDs for operational history only. Does not change volunteer or membership branch mappings or their exclusions.

fields.label: Source connection
fields.description: Bulk Export connects directly to the VMMS Export companion app on the old v15 site and supports resumable transfers.

fields.label: Old site URL
fields.description: HTTPS origin of the old live site. Use a System Manager with unrestricted read access.

fields.label: Allow phone numbers requiring review
fields.description: Leave invalid profile and reference phones blank and report their original values for review. Omit emergency contacts with invalid required primary phones. Originals remain in the protected source capture/archive; the main original phone also stays on the profile.

fields.label: Treat old emergency contacts as permission to call
Preserve existing passwords
fields.description: Bulk Export only. Hosting must register this target’s public key and enable protected login export on the source. Existing hashes transfer encrypted; passwords are never requested.

fields.label: Allow reviewed attachment exceptions
fields.description: Import available verified files and retain missing-file reports. Missing files are never replaced with unrelated bytes.

fields.label: Allow reviewed source identity exceptions (maximum 1%)
fields.description: Review all source-exclusion reports first. Allows up to 1% of people and separately up to 1% of accounts to remain in restricted history when their source identity cannot be migrated safely. Runtime import failures still block cutover.

fields.label: Preserve source email-link sign-in
fields.description: When the source uses email-link login, preserve that sign-in route for accounts without a local password. Existing destination MFA is never disabled. Configure and test destination email delivery before cutover.
